goal: Recreate the feel and motion of Slack's desktop app: the purple sidebar and channel list, message hover actions, the compose box, and the exact easing curves, durations and colors of its transitions
summary: A single-page web app that reproduces Slack's desktop UI feel and motion: the purple sidebar and channel list, message hover actions (reply/thread/react/three-dot menu), the compose box, and Slack's exact transition easing curves, durations and colors. Verified via DOM property checks, timing checks for animation durations, and visual checks for overall feel.

checks.criteria: Sidebar background color equals Slack purple #43195F

checks.criteria: Sidebar item hover background color equals #2D1B3B

checks.criteria: Sidebar item hover transition duration is 150ms with ease-out easing

checks.criteria: Message hover actions become visible within 150ms of hover

environment.rationale: This is a web UI recreation goal requiring a headless Chromium browser in a Linux VM to verify DOM styles, animation timings, and visual feel. No GPU, desktop native app, macOS, or API secrets beyond the standard CRUSOE_API_KEY and NTFY_TOPIC are needed.

design_facts: Slack sidebar text: #FFFFFF, unread indicator dot: #E01E5A (pink/red)
Slack message hover actions appear on hover with 150ms ease-out fade
Slack hover action icons: reply, thread, react, more (three dots)
Slack compose box: rounded rectangle, #FFFFFF background, 1px #D5D8DC border, placeholder #868E96 text
Slack compose box focus: border #4A154B (purple), box-shadow 0 0 0 2px rgba(74,21,75,0.2)
Slack transition easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) for standard ease-out
Slack message hover action reveal: 150ms ease-out
Slack compose box height: 44px default, expands on focus
Slack font: 'Slack-Lato', 'Lato', sans-serif; sidebar text 14px, channel list 14px, messages 15px
